frontend_rendering_protocols.purpose: Rules for producing browser-renderable frontend deliverables that are consistent, previewable, and deliverable through the platform version system.

default_stack.exceptions: Skip the React workflow only when the user explicitly requests Vue, Svelte, Angular, vanilla HTML, or a non-web-UI task.

design_defaults.priority: Artifact skill technical constraints override base visual defaults when they conflict.

workflow.rule: Write plan.md first for complex or skill-related frontend work.
Load vibecoding-webapp-swarm for web UI tasks; compose with webapp-building-swarm for React artifact production.
If the frontend needs APIs, auth, persistence, database-backed server state, or server-side data, compose with backend-building-swarm and swarm-workspace.
Use scoped subagents for complex UI, state, data integration, and validation; provide guidance, context, and mission.
Build static React/Vite projects before delivery when applicable.
Call website_version_manager with action build_version before the final response.

static_frontend.project_dir: React/Vite source project root, not dist.

server_backed.backend_rule: Use backend-building-swarm for real backend, API, database, auth, persistence, or server-side data.

delivery_rules.preview_statement: Say the website version is saved and ready to preview via the version card.
delivery_rules.publish_statement: Do not claim deployed, online, live, published, launched, 已部署, 已上线, 已发布, or 上线成功 unless the user actually published.

quality_gates.visual_consistency: Shared design tokens, spacing, typography, color palette, and component behavior must remain consistent across pages.
quality_gates.responsive_behavior: Layouts must remain usable across desktop and mobile widths.
quality_gates.state_integrity: Interactive components must have explicit state handling and no dead controls unless intentionally static.
quality_gates.data_integrity: External facts and figures must be sourced when required; mock data must be clearly structured and replaceable.
quality_gates.accessibility: Use semantic HTML, readable contrast, focus states, labels, and keyboard-navigable controls.
quality_gates.performance: Avoid unnecessary dependencies, oversized assets, blocking scripts, and unoptimized images.

forbidden_patterns: backend mock presented as real persistence
SQLite-only backend instructions for online full-stack swarm webapps
